rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Time Technoplast Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates on entering into Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Promoters of Ebullient Packaging Private Limited (EPPL) for acquisition of 74 percent stake in EPPL.
